items.caption: Cruise Power
items.details:
Limits: TQ see below / 820° ITT / 104% N1 / 1700 RPM
Recommended propeller: 1500 RPM
Maximum cruise power at ISA:
SL to 20,000 ft...100% TQ → ~260-240 KIAS
@ 22,000 ft...95% TQ → ~225 KIAS
@ 24,000 ft...85% TQ → ~217 KIAS
@ 26,000 ft...80% TQ → ~209 KIAS
@ 28,000 ft...75% TQ → ~200 KIAS
@ 30,000 ft...70% TQ → ~190 KIAS
@ 33,000 ft...60% TQ → ~175 KIAS
@ 35,000 ft...55% TQ → ~162 KIAS
Normal cruise power: subtract 5% TQ from maximum cruise power from 18,000 ft on and above
Maximum range power: 45% TQ

items.caption: Top of Descent (TOD)
items.details:
Start descent latest at approx. (Altitude/1000)*3 NM + 10 NM before destination
Sink rate for 3° glidepath = 5 x Ground Speed

items.caption: Descent Power
items.details: Sink rate for a 3° glidepath ~ 5 x Ground Speed

items.caption: NAVI/CDI
items.action: SET VLOC IF REQ FOR ILS

items.caption: Visual Approach
items.details:
Enter downwind leg @ 1000 ft AGL
@ 8-7 NM to go: reduce speed to ~150-160 KIAS, set FLAPS 1 (APPROACH) @ ~160 KIAS
@ downwind leg or ~6 NM: reduce speed to ~120 KIAS, lower LANDING GEAR (mid downwind), set Flaps 2 (DOWN) @ ~140 KIAS
@ base leg or ~3 NM: YAW Damper OFF, propeller levers FULL FORWARD, start descending, sink rate ~500-1000 fpm
Airspeed on final VREF ~ 100-110 KIAS

items.caption: ILS Approach
items.details:
Be @ ~3000 ft above destination airport elevation or use proper procedure altitudes
@ 15-12 NM to go: reduce speed to ~150-160 KIAS, set FLAPS 1 (APPROACH) @ ~160 KIAS
@ glideslope capture: start descending, sink rate for 3° glidepath = 5 x Ground Speed
@ ~6 NM to go: reduce speed to ~120 KIAS, lower LANDING GEAR, set Flaps 2 (DOWN) @ ~140 KIAS
@ ~3 NM to go: Autopilot OFF, YAW Damper OFF, propeller levers FULL FORWARD
Airspeed on final VREF ~ 100-110 KIAS
